poses.name: Sitting leaning back, one knee raised
poses.desc: sitting on the floor leaning back with her torso arched slightly backward, one knee raised and bent, the other leg extended forward, both hands resting on the floor behind her for support

poses.name: Sitting, one-hand support, legs swept forward

poses.name: Lying prone propped on both elbows
